answer: We formulate a decentralized consensus mechanism where each validator stakes an escalating dynamic opportunity cost bond mapped through a cryptographic kernel to suppress identity fragmentation across the network ocean. By deploying subgame-perfect slashing matrices that exponentially penalize correlated misbehavior along every adversarial thread, the expected utility of Sybil multiplication is driven strictly negative. Consequently, rational validators converge on a robust Nash equilibrium where single-identity participation uniquely maximizes long-term yields.
